en.title: Debussy: String Quartet in G minor, Op.10 – IV. Très modéré
en.overview: This is a long finale for four players: two violins, viola and cello. It runs 355 measures and ends in G major. Keys and chords here are estimated by computer, and the key changes very often, so treat them as a rough guide. Listen for the cello opening alone, the loud peak in the allegro, the long quiet stretches, and the loud finish. The score has a few small errors, so fine details may be imprecise.

listening_points.headline: The cello begins alone, softly
listening_points.text: The cello plays by itself at the start [m. 1-2]. The level is soft (p). The score marks a swell and then a fade here.

listening_points.headline: The first violin takes the lead, very softly
listening_points.text: Violin 1 takes the lead at [m. 3-4]. It is very soft (pp). The estimated key is C# minor at [m. 3] and A major at [m. 4].

listening_points.headline: Soft, shifting harmony in the opening part
listening_points.text: The lead passes between Violin 2 and Violin 1. The music is mostly soft, with a brief rise to medium loud (mf) at [m. 10]. The estimated key moves to Db major at [m. 6] and E major by [m. 12]. The players often move together in chords here, which is called homophonic.

listening_points.headline: Allegretto: cello alone, then a louder burst
listening_points.text: The cello is alone again at [m. 15-16]. A duet follows at [m. 17-18], and the lead there is uncertain. The music is loud (f) at [m. 25-28]. The cello is alone again at [m. 29-30], and the volume is p and then pp.

listening_points.headline: Allegro starts quiet, then gets louder
listening_points.text: The faster allegro begins softly at [m. 31]. The viola probably has the tune first. The music swells at [m. 34] and is loud (f) at [m. 35]. Violin 1 probably leads there. A similar pattern comes at [m. 39-43].

listening_points.headline: Building to the estimated loudest point
listening_points.text: The volume rises from mp at [m. 45] to mf at [m. 49]. It then reaches f at [m. 51] and ff at [m. 53]. A computer estimate marks [m. 54] as the loudest and busiest point. The estimated key is C# minor there.

listening_points.headline: Calm after the peak, with the viola prominent
listening_points.text: The music is soft (p) from [m. 59]. The viola probably leads around [m. 62-68]. At [m. 68] the viola is alone. Then it is very soft (pp) at [m. 69-76], in an estimated Bb major from [m. 71].

listening_points.headline: Interwoven lines grow to a second loud peak
listening_points.text: From [m. 77] the lines move on their own and nobody clearly leads. The level is f at [m. 86]. It reaches ff at [m. 90], and this stays through [m. 97]. The estimated key is F# major at [m. 93].

listening_points.headline: Hush, then loud, then a lone violin
listening_points.text: The volume is p at [m. 98] and pp at [m. 99]. It stays quiet until [m. 113]. It is then loud (f) at [m. 114]. Violin 2 plays alone at [m. 123-124].

listening_points.headline: A tempo section, soft and singing
listening_points.text: A section marked "A tempo" begins at [m. 125]. It is soft (p). Violin 2 leads and is alone at [m. 126] and [m. 131]. The estimated key is E major from [m. 132]. The viola probably takes over around [m. 133].

listening_points.headline: Very soft, then building to loud in stages
listening_points.text: A new key signature begins at [m. 141], in very soft playing (pp). The music swells at [m. 143]. It reaches mf at [m. 149] and f at [m. 157]. The lead is often uncertain.

listening_points.headline: A very loud burst inside the long section
listening_points.text: After a quiet stretch, the music is very loud (ff) from [m. 181] through [m. 188]. The lines are independent. It is p again at [m. 189].

listening_points.headline: Hushed cello solo, then quiet music
listening_points.text: The cello is alone and very soft at [m. 213-215]. The viola leads next. The lead then passes to Violin 2 and Violin 1 at [m. 218-219]. Much of the music from [m. 216] to [m. 251] is soft (pp or p).

listening_points.headline: Loud chords, then soft, then rebuilding
listening_points.text: A new section begins at [m. 252] with a sudden ff. The players move together in chords. The sound stays ff to [m. 267]. It is p at [m. 268]. It then reaches f at [m. 282].

listening_points.headline: Soft, a brief loud moment, then calm again
listening_points.text: A new section at [m. 289] is soft (p). It is loud (f) at [m. 295], with Violin 1 leading. It is p again at [m. 299-307], in an estimated E major and A major.

listening_points.headline: The last section: a cello solo and a soft stretch
listening_points.text: The final section starts loud (f) at [m. 308]. It is p at [m. 317]. The cello is alone at [m. 319]. The viola probably takes the tune for the next stretch.

listening_points.headline: A rush to a loud close in G major
listening_points.text: The music is loud (f) from [m. 349] and reaches ff at [m. 353]. The estimated key becomes G major at [m. 351]. The analysis labels [m. 354] as silent (tacet), but this may be wrong. The final chord in [m. 355] is in G major.

glossary.explanation: All the players move together, like chords under or with one tune.
One part has the tune and the others support it.
Each player has their own line, so there is no single clear tune.
A part or a whole group does not play.

glossary.term: pp, p, mp, mf, f, ff
glossary.explanation: Loudness levels, from very soft to very loud.
The home note and scale that the music centres on. Here keys are estimated by computer.
The sharps or flats written at the start of a line, which set the key. A new one marks a new section.

zh.title: 德彪西：G小调弦乐四重奏，Op.10 第四乐章（Très modéré）听赏指南
zh.overview: 本乐章共355小节，由四件乐器演奏：第一小提琴、第二小提琴、中提琴和大提琴。开头安静，由大提琴独自引出。随后速度和力度多次变化，有几处推向很强。最后在G大调上收束。需要说明：和声与调性都是软件自动估计的，可能有误。主奏声部的判断也只是估算。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴弱起，独自开场
listening_points.text: 乐章以大提琴独奏开始[m. 1-2]。力度是弱（p）。估计的调性是升C小调。大提琴的主奏判断很有把握。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴接过领奏，力度很弱
listening_points.text: [m. 3-4]第一小提琴接过领奏。此处力度变为很弱（pp）。[m. 3]几条线各自独立。[m. 4]变为旋律加伴奏。

listening_points.headline: Allegretto：大提琴再次独奏
listening_points.text: [m. 15]进入标有“allegretto”的新段落。大提琴再次独奏，力度为弱。

listening_points.headline: 渐强，转入强
listening_points.text: [m. 19-20]有渐强标记，力度逐渐增大。[m. 21-24]几条线各自独立进行。到[m. 25]达到强（f）。

listening_points.headline: Allegro 开始：先弱后强
listening_points.text: [m. 31]进入“allegro”段落，力度为弱。[m. 34]有渐强标记。[m. 35]起变强（f），各声部以主调织体（同步的和弦式）进行。

listening_points.headline: 一路推向全乐章最响处
listening_points.text: [m. 49]起渐强，[m. 51]为强（f）。[m. 53-54]达到很强（ff）。分析软件把[m. 54]估为最响最忙之处。此处估计为升C小调。

listening_points.headline: 转弱，中提琴领衔
listening_points.text: [m. 57]标有渐弱，[m. 59]力度变弱（p）。[m. 62-68]中提琴大概是主奏，其余声部伴奏。[m. 68]是中提琴独奏。

listening_points.headline: 很弱的一段，明亮的降B大调
listening_points.text: [m. 69]起力度为很弱（pp）。[m. 71-76]估计调性是降B大调。主奏在几件乐器间转移。

listening_points.headline: 第二个高潮：强到很强
listening_points.text: [m. 84]标有渐强，[m. 86]变强（f）。[m. 89]有渐强标记，[m. 90]达到很强（ff）。几条线各自独立，织体较密。[m. 93-96]估计转入升F大调。

listening_points.headline: 安静下来，反复推进
listening_points.text: [m. 94]和[m. 96]标有渐弱，[m. 98]力度变弱（p），[m. 99]更弱（pp）。后面有多次渐强和渐弱。第一小提琴大多可能是主奏。估计调性多在升G小调。

listening_points.headline: 第二小提琴独奏，A tempo 段落
listening_points.text: [m. 123-124]第二小提琴独奏。[m. 125]进入标为“A tempo 1”的段落。[m. 126]与[m. 131]又是独奏。

listening_points.headline: 很弱的新段落，渐强到中强
listening_points.text: [m. 141]进入新调号段落，力度为很弱（pp）。[m. 148]有渐强标记，[m. 149]变为中强（mf）。第一小提琴可能是主奏，把握不大。

listening_points.headline: 突然爆发为很强
listening_points.text: [m. 181]突然变为很强（ff）。[m. 187]标有渐弱，[m. 189]回到弱（p）。这里的主奏很不确定，更像是共同承担。

listening_points.headline: 大提琴独奏，几件乐器轮流接力
listening_points.text: [m. 213-215]大提琴独奏，力度很弱（pp）。接着中提琴、第二小提琴、第一小提琴依次领奏[m. 216-219]。这些主奏判断把握较大。

listening_points.headline: 很强的和弦式段落
listening_points.text: [m. 252]进入新调号段落，力度为很强（ff）。[m. 252-255]是主调织体，各声部节奏一致。[m. 267]带有渐弱标记。

listening_points.headline: 终于落在G大调
listening_points.text: [m. 351]起估计调性是G大调。[m. 353]达到很强（ff）。分析把[m. 354]标为没有乐器演奏，但这个标签不一定准确。[m. 355]以和弦式织体结束。

glossary.explanation: 几个声部同时、节奏相近地行进，像一串整齐的和弦。
一个声部唱出旋律，其他声部在下面衬托。
乐谱上的速度标记，表示回到原来的速度。
乐曲当时所围绕的中心音与明暗色彩。本指南的调性是软件估计的。
